title: Base Power pinned rail
description: A pinned product tour: a green heading with a hand-drawn underline, a list of four points along a grey rail, two buttons, and a large rounded photo. While the section is pinned an orange bar grows down the rail; at each quarter the next point turns green, grows and opens its text, and the photo crossfades in from a slight zoom. Rises in as it arrives; phones put the photo on top.
notes: pinned for 4.2 windows on phones, 3.6 on desktop (the section is 520svh / 460svh tall); four points read best
CSS scroll timelines only, no JavaScript; without support, or with reduced motion, it is a plain section with every point open and the first photo shown
keep each point's text to about three lines: the open state is capped at 8rem
